evidence: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template environment/Dockerfile (diff empty; sha256 0a75419e...). Line 1 `FROM node:22-bookworm-slim` (tag-pinned base, the template's own pin); line 3 `ENV NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules`; lines 9-12 `npm install -g --no-audit --no-fund express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1` (exact versions, global, matching NODE_PATH and matching tests/Dockerfile lines 20-21 and test.sh line 106 `NODE_PATH="/usr/local/lib/node_modules"`); line 14 `COPY instructions/ /instructions/`; line 15 `COPY assets/ /assets/`; line 16 `chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets`; lines 17-23 create /app, git init, commit only .gitkeep. No COPY/ADD of solution/ or tests/. task.toml has no [environment].docker_image. Both COPY sources exist (six notes named by instruction.md 'the six notes in /instructions'; assets/seed_data.json parses). Declared world matches: integration.md says 'The launch image supplies Node 22, Express and better-sqlite3 through NODE_PATH' and 'opening the finished app must not require an install or build step'. Golden runtime needs only what is pre-installed: solution/app/server.js requires only node:path, node:fs, express, better-sqlite3 (lines 2-5); the frontend (React, prettier, acorn, lezer) is pre-bundled in public/assets/index.js and public/index.html references only /assets/index.js and /assets/index.css (URL scan of the bundle found only namespace/doc strings, no CDN load); solve.sh performs only a cp -a, no npm install, and test.sh has no install step. Run evidence: raw-evidence-index artifact hashes recomputed and matching for run_golden.sh (a94328b9...), runtime.json (e47b63b0...), restart.json (265afb96...), editor.json (0e98f453...), polish.json (d65b6cf7...); run_golden.sh installs with solve.sh into an agent-image container and launches with env -i, NODE_PATH, uid 65534, cwd /tmp, and runtime.json shows cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing true with pageErrors []. Local image cw-editor-agent-r3 has a docker history that matches this Dockerfile step for step (ENV NODE_PATH, apt line, npm -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1, both COPYs, chmod/git init, WORKDIR /app, CMD sleep infinity), so the Dockerfile is shown to build and to carry the runtime the golden starts on. Notes (not defects, template-controlled): the base is a floating tag rather than a digest and apt packages are unversioned (workbook check-dockerfiles: 'unpinned apt is a NOTE'); solution/app/package.json lists bundled front-end packages under dependencies that are not in the image (check-package-manifest-deps-preinstalled is NOTE under public network, and they are not needed at run time). Limitation: cw-editor-agent-r3 was created 2026-10-01T22:19Z, before the 2 October edits to environment/instructions, so its /instructions layer is older than these bytes; no build of the agent image from exactly these bytes was observed in this review. That affects note content inside that image only, not whether the unchanged Dockerfile builds or what runtime it installs. Weak-app probe: a submission needing `npm install` at grade time fails to start in the verifier, which is the publicly stated contract, not a harness defect; a conforming alternative that vendors /app/node_modules is permitted by integration.md and test.sh symlink rule.
